title: Laptop and Desktop
summary: Learn the difference between a laptop and a desktop.
objectives: Distinguish between laptop and desktop computers

content.text: Some computers are big and sit on a desk. They are called Desktops. Some computers are small and fold up. They are called Laptops.

points.text: Laptop: Folds up and can be carried.

steps.boltSpeech: Can you put the computers in the right place?
steps.instructions: Sort the computers into Desktops and Laptops.

questions.prompt: Which computer can you fold and take with you?

options.label: Desktop
options.image: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100"><rect x="20" y="20" width="60" height="50" fill="#333"/></svg>

feedback.correct: Correct! A laptop is easy to carry.
feedback.incorrect: A desktop is usually too big to carry around.
